case_number: Civil Appeal No. 1846 of 2022 (Arising out of SLP (Civil) No. 2103 of 2022)
summary: Challenge to High Court's quashing of contract award for road reconstruction; issue of whether judicial review逾 stepped into appellate domain; tender evaluation found non-uniform; Supreme Court emphasized limitations on judicial interference in administrative contracts, citing need to avoid arbitrariness while respecting expertise and finality; held that courts should not substitute their judgment for that of technical authorities absent illegality, irrationality, or procedural impropriety.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 14 of the Constitution of India
Tata Cellular v. Union of India, (1994) 6 SCC 651
R. v. Secretary of State for the Home Department, ex p. Brind, (1991) 1 AC 696
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; appellant permitted to complete the project but cannot claim escalation for the period during which the matter was pending before the court.
